text:
harper: Heads-up: found a docs/bug in the Bulk Embeddings endpoint examples. The API ref currently shows a single `input` string in examples but the actual endpoint expects `inputs` as an array of strings. This is breaking a couple of SDK integration tests.
nina: Oof. Which files?
harper: docs/api-ref/endpoints/embeddings_bulk.md and docs/snippets/ts/bulk_embed_example.ts
harper: Current curl example in embeddings_bulk.md:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/bulk" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input":"The quick brown fox"}'
```
harper: Should be an array: 
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/bulk" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"inputs":["The quick brown fox","A second sentence"]}'
```
ian: Also the TypeScript snippet shows the request body as a plain string: `body: 'hello'` which made the TS SDK tests fail. We should update the typed example to show `inputs: string[]` and the response shape `embeddings: number[][]`.
maria: Can we add an explicit OpenAPI example update too? I think the examples in docs/api-ref/schema/embeddings.yaml are used by the snippet generator. If the YAML example still has `input` single string, the generator will re-create the bad example.
harper: Good catch. I'll update the OpenAPI examples and the snippet files. I'll also add a short migration note for older clients that previously sent newline-delimited JSON or single strings: suggest `if typeof body.input === 'string' then body.inputs = [body.input]` as a fallback.
nina: Also add a clarification about response ordering: the embeddings array index maps 1:1 to the inputs array order. We've had confusion where folks assume sorted by score or deduped. Add a one-liner under "Response" that the server preserves input order.
ian: For the TS snippet, show a typed interface and parsing example: `const body = await resp.json(); const first = body.embeddings[0];`
maria: I'll review the OpenAPI change. We should also run the snippet generator locally to confirm no other endpoints got incorrectly flattened arrays.
docs-bot: PR opened by @harper: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/docs/pulls/8720 reviewers: @nina @maria @ian
nina: Reviewing now, leaving a nit about wording for the migration tip.
harper: Fixed wording and added the TS example with typed `inputs: string[]` and a Go example showing `[]string{"a","b"}`.
maria: Approving the PR. I ran the snippet generator and it looks good; fixed one more stray example in docs/snippets/python/embeds_quickstart.md.
harper: Merged. I'll drop a small changelog entry in docs/CHANGELOG.md and ping eng-qa to re-run the SDK integration suite. Thanks all :tada:
